package dynamoevents

import (
	"testing"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/aws"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/dynamodb"
	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go/service/dynamodb/dynamodbattribute"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestFieldsMapPreservesJSON(t *testing.T) {
	const original = `{"type":"test","empty":"","object":{},"list":[],"nested":{"items":[true,null,{"number":12345678901234567890},1.25,1e3]}}`
	converted, err := convertLegacyFields(original)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotNil(t, converted.M)
	require.Equal(t, aws.String(""), converted.M["empty"].S)
	require.NotNil(t, converted.M["object"].M)
	require.NotNil(t, converted.M["list"].L)
	require.Equal(t, "12345678901234567890", aws.StringValue(converted.M["nested"].M["items"].L[2].M["number"].N))

	fields, err := decodeJSONFields([]byte(original))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	item, err := marshalEvent(event{SessionID: "session", EventIndex: 1, FieldsMap: fields})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotContains(t, item, keyFields)
	require.NotNil(t, item[keyFieldsMap].M)

	var read event
	require.NoError(t, unmarshalEvent(item, &read))
	data, err := eventJSON(&read)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.JSONEq(t, original, string(data))
	_, err = eventFields(&read)
	require.NoError(t, err)
}

func TestLegacyFieldsReadableDuringMigration(t *testing.T) {
	const original = `{"type":"test","user":"alice","index":2}`
	item, err := dynamodbattribute.MarshalMap(event{SessionID: "session", EventIndex: 2, Fields: original})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var read event
	require.NoError(t, unmarshalEvent(item, &read))
	fields, err := eventFields(&read)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "alice", fields["user"])

	keyBefore, err := getSubPageCheckpoint(&read)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	item[keyFieldsMap], err = convertLegacyFields(original)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	delete(item, keyFields)
	require.NoError(t, unmarshalEvent(item, &read))
	keyAfter, err := getSubPageCheckpoint(&read)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, keyBefore, keyAfter)
	fields, err = eventFields(&read)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "alice", fields["user"])
}

func TestConvertLegacyFieldsRejectsInvalidJSON(t *testing.T) {
	for _, data := range []string{"", "null", "[]", `{"a":1} {"b":2}`, `{"a":`} {
		t.Run(data, func(t *testing.T) {
			_, err := convertLegacyFields(data)
			require.Error(t, err)
		})
	}
}

func TestEventFieldsPrefersMap(t *testing.T) {
	fields, err := decodeJSONFields([]byte(`{"user":"new"}`))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	e := event{Fields: `{"user":"old"}`, FieldsMap: fields}
	read, err := eventFields(&e)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "new", read["user"])
}

func TestFieldsMapAttributeIsQueryable(t *testing.T) {
	fields, err := decodeJSONFields([]byte(`{"user":{"name":"alice"},"success":true}`))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	item, err := marshalEvent(event{SessionID: "session", EventIndex: 3, FieldsMap: fields})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "alice", aws.StringValue(item[keyFieldsMap].M["user"].M["name"].S))
	require.Equal(t, aws.Bool(true), item[keyFieldsMap].M["success"].BOOL)
	require.IsType(t, &dynamodb.AttributeValue{}, item[keyFieldsMap])
}

item.text:
Implemented native DynamoDB `FieldsMap` storage for new audit events, with reads that continue to support legacy `Fields` records. Added a batched, resumable migration with conversion validation, progress logging, a distributed lock, and a completion flag. See [event storage](/app/lib/events/dynamoevents/dynamoevents.go), [migration](/app/lib/events/dynamoevents/fields_migration.go), and [FlagKey](/app/lib/backend/helpers.go:34).

Offline tests passed for `./lib/events/dynamoevents` and `./lib/backend`. The AWS-dependent integration test requires the repository’s AWS test setting and did not run.
